name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: North of Auberdine, Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze fears trouble at an ancient ruin. She sent Balthule Shadowstrike to watch the Tower of Althalaxx, but he has missed his report.

sections.title: A Scout Unaccounted For
sections.body: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze watches for danger around Auberdine. Suspicious activity near the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore drew her notice, so she sent Balthule Shadowstrike to watch the ancient ruin. Days have passed without word from him. Elissa asks you to travel north, find Balthule, and make sure he has not met an untimely end.

sections.title: Eyes Upon the Ruin
sections.body: The road north from Auberdine passes ancient Kaldorei ruins and crosses the Cliffspring River before reaching the tower. Balthule survived his first watch, though he could not send word back to Auberdine. You find him in the surrounding woods, where he confirms Elissa's fears: dark and troubling events are underway inside the crumbling stone spire.

faq.answer: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze is a night elf Sentinel stationed in Auberdine. She protects the settlement from dangers across Darkshore and watches for threats such as the Tower of Althalaxx.
Balthule Shadowstrike is the scout Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze sent to watch strange activity around the Tower of Althalaxx. He keeps watch outside the ruin for signs of hostile forces.

faq.q: Where is the Tower of Althalaxx located?
faq.answer: The Tower of Althalaxx stands in northeastern Darkshore. From Auberdine, head east and follow the northern road past Bashal'Aran, then cross the bridge over the Cliffspring River until the spire comes into view.

faq.q: Why was a scout sent to the tower in the first place?
faq.answer: Elissa sent Balthule to watch strange activity around the Tower of Althalaxx as part of her duty to protect Auberdine.

faq.q: Why hasn't Balthule returned to Auberdine?
faq.answer: Elissa has not received Balthule's report, so she asks you to check on him. Balthule can explain his situation when you find him.
Yes. Finding Balthule Shadowstrike begins a multi-part investigation into the dark forces occupying the Tower of Althalaxx and their ambitions in Darkshore.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Althalaxx's ruins recall the fallen highborne of ancient Kalimdor. Corruption festers in their stones, and guarding Auberdine against it is a vital duty for the sentinels.
As an Alliance traveler, you rely on Auberdine as the Alliance's main gateway into northern Kalimdor. Its surrounding roads and borders need protection.
